title_en: 2026 Korea Biosafety Association On-Site Biosafety Training (Biological Safety Cabinet Management)
summary: Those who wish to attend the Korean Biosafety Association's on-site biosafety training must complete the participation application form and submit it by email between 19 October and 29 October 2026; the email address is in the original notice. The training takes place on 17 November 2026, 13:30–16:30, at the Safety Experience Center classroom, 1st floor, SNU Environmental Health and Safety Center (Building 97). Places are limited to 50 and are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

dates.what: Registration period (application form submitted by email)

conditions: Places are limited to 50 and are filled on a first-come, first-served basis.
The training is free of charge.
Applications are accepted only by email, using the participation application form provided as an attachment.
steps: Read the attached guide (2026 찾아가는 생물안전 현장교육 안내.hwp); its content was not read for this translation.
Download and complete the attached participation application form (2026 찾아가는 생물안전 현장교육 참가신청서(추가접수).xlsx).
Email the completed form between 19 and 29 October 2026 to the address given in the original notice.
Attend the training on 17 November 2026 at 13:30 at the Safety Experience Center classroom, 1st floor, SNU Environmental Health and Safety Center (Building 97).
translation:
Title: 2026 Korean Biosafety Association On-Site Biosafety Training

□ 2026 Korean Biosafety Association "On-Site Biosafety Training" [찾아가는 생물안전 현장교육]
- Organiser: Korean Biosafety Association (incorporated association)
- Sponsors: Seoul National University Environmental Health and Safety Center [환경안전원]; International CLS [국제씨엘에스]
- Date and time: Tuesday 17 November 2026, 13:30–16:30 (3 hours)
- Venue: Safety Experience Center classroom [안전체험센터 교육장], 1st floor, Seoul National University Environmental Health and Safety Center (Building 97)
- Training content: Safety management of biological safety cabinets
- Participation fee: Free
- Capacity: 50 persons (first-come, first-served)
- Registration period: Monday 19 October 2026 to Thursday 29 October 2026
- How to register: Complete the participation application form (template) and submit it by email (the email address is given in the original notice).

Attachments (2):
2026 찾아가는 생물안전 현장교육 안내.hwp (160 KB) – training guide
2026 찾아가는 생물안전 현장교육 참가신청서(추가접수).xlsx (15 KB) – participation application form (additional registration)

Note: The contents of the attachments were not read for this translation.
